segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Jordan. I wanted to confirm the seat count and the rollout timing so I can get the order form cleaned up today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 seats for the initial team, with 6 more likely in Q2. I’d rather not bake those in yet unless it changes the pricing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. At 42 seats you’re still in the same tier we reviewed, so it’s $68 per seat per month on an annual term. The 6 later can be added at the same rate, prorated.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that works. On invoicing, can you do one annual invoice instead of monthly? Finance asked for that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, annual upfront is standard. That would put the first invoice at $34,272 before tax, due net 30 from signature. I’ll make sure billing has the PO field included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. PO should be 4817-AC, and the billing contact is ap@northlinecomponents.com.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For go-live, we had May 13 as the target. Is that still realistic if procurement signs by Friday?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. Our admin is available the week of May 6 for setup, and we want managers trained before May 13. The only blocker is legal finishing the DPA.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Deal desk approved the standard DPA language yesterday, so I’ll resend the packet with that attached and the order form updated for 42 seats, annual billing, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Priya in procurement. If it matches what we discussed, we should be able to turn it by April 26.
